endpoints.name: Cloud Video Intelligence API

endpoints.name: Cloud Vision API

endpoints.description: Ethereum Up or Down 30-Minute Probability estimates p_up and p_down for half-hour windows using the widest caller-supplied context in this family. Send 8-240 ordered caller-supplied ETH price observations, the target venue's opening price, and its close timestamp; optionally include UP/DOWN share prices and entry fees for a descriptive model-edge comparison. Returns a conservative probability pair, lean, input-quality score, model contract, and warnings for $0.003 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana

endpoints.description: Look up any transaction and its receipt by hash on 28 EVM chains: success or revert, block number, gas used, effective gas price, sender and recipient. endpoints.description: Read any wallet balance on 28 EVM chains: native coin (ETH, BNB, MATIC, AVAX) or any ERC-20 token including USDC. endpoints.description: Hourly electricity generation by fuel source for any US balancing authority, with the carbon-free share computed from wind, solar, hydro, nuclear and geothermal. Storage is excluded from both sides because discharging shifts power rather than generating it, and "other/unknown" is never counted as clean - so the share errs low. Method returned with the numbers.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Hourly US electricity demand, day-ahead demand forecast, net generation and total interchange for any of 83 balancing authorities - CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP, Bonneville, or US48 for the whole Lower 48. Straight from EIA open data, grouped by hour so an agent reads one object per hour instead of four raw series.

The response lists which lists were searched and which were not: a name-similarity search, not a compliance determination.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents

Straight from the NIST National Vulnerability Database.

The response says plainly what these are: published once per business day around 16:00 CET, not a live market rate and not tradeable.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: How much token_out a swap returns right now: direct pools and the route through the wrapped native token, across Uniswap V2/V3 (PancakeSwap on BNB Chain) and every fee tier, with price impact and the pools on the route. Quotes only - nothing is built, signed or sent.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Current USD and native price of any ERC-20 by contract address, read straight from the deepest Uniswap V2/V3 pool (PancakeSwap on BNB Chain) against the wrapped native token and converted through the deepest stablecoin pool. Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain; Robinhood Chain in native terms. Returns the pool used, its depth and a thin-liquidity warning. No API key.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Read a token's DEX pair straight from the chain: pair address, both reserves, the implied price, LP total supply and how much of that LP sits in burn addresses. Base, Arbitrum and BNB Chain, Uniswap V2-style factories against the wrapped native token. Read-only eth_call, no API key. The answer states its own limits: no pair here does not mean no liquidity, because V3, other DEXes and non-native quote pairs are not covered.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Replace personal data in text with typed placeholders. Emails, phone numbers, cards, IBANs and IP addresses are matched by exact pattern and never left to the model - the deterministic cases cannot be missed. Names, addresses and ids are judged by a model, and output shorter than half the input is rejected, so redaction never silently deletes text. The method is returned with the result.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Sentiment as one of positive, negative, neutral or mixed, with a -1 to 1 score and a one-line reason. "Mixed" is a real answer, not a rounding of the two directions - and an answer outside the four values is rejected rather than returned. Fixed price per call.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Translate text into any target language, detecting the source when you do not give it. Proper nouns, numbers, code and formatting are kept as they are. Returns the translation alone, with no preamble to strip. Fixed price per call.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Summarize text into a set number of sentences, or into bullet points. Uses only what the text says and adds nothing. Input is bounded at 8000 characters, which is what makes a fixed price per call possible instead of per-token billing.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Pull named fields out of free text as JSON - names, dates, amounts, references, anything you list. Every field you ask for appears in the answer: one the text does not contain comes back null rather than guessed, so "not in the text" and "model did not answer" are never confused. Fixed price per call.

endpoints.name: DexL Agents
endpoints.description: Assign text to one of the labels you supply - support tickets, intents, topics, spam or not, anything. The returned label is checked against your list, so the model cannot invent a category: an answer outside your labels is rejected rather than passed through. Comes back with a confidence and a one-line reason. Fixed price per call.

Laevitas API V2
endpoints.description:
Professional market data API for crypto derivatives, spot markets, prediction markets, Hyperliquid HyperCore data, proprietary volatility surfaces, and analytics.

## Authentication

Use an API key for authenticated REST requests:

```http
X-API-Key: your-api-key-here
```

Most data endpoints also support x402 pay-per-request without an API key.

**Subscriptions with USDC:** Premium and Enterprise can be purchased on Base or Solana for a month, a quarter, six months or a year. Access is prepaid, with no automatic renewal. [Buy a subscription](https://v3.laevitas.ch/profile/subscription/wallet) or read the [USDC subscription guide](/x402#subscriptions).

The subscription belongs to your signed-in Laevitas account; wallet sign-in does not require an email. Enterprise users generate an API key in V3 after activation. Plan and billing-period limits still apply. Subscription purchases are separate from API credit bundles.

For Claude MCP, add `https://apiv2.laevitas.ch/api/v1/mcp`, select **Sign in now → Register automatically**
with no custom headers, and authorize with your API key on the Laevitas page.
Do not enter a client ID or secret manually. All OAuth clients require PKCE S256.
Connection guide: [MCP setup](/mcp). CIMD / published client identity is not supported.

| Resource | Path |
| --- | --- |
| OpenAPI JSON | `GET /openapi.json` |
| x402 discovery | `GET /.well-known/x402` |
| Changelog | `GET /api/v1/changelog` |
| WebSocket docs | `GET /websocket` |

## REST Surfaces

| Surface | Examples |
| --- | --- |
| Instruments | Cross-market contract reference data |
| Futures | OHLCVT, trades, tickers, orderbook, liquidations, carry |
| Perpetuals | OHLCVT, trades, funding, open interest, orderbook, liquidations |
| Options | OHLCVT, trades, Greeks, volatility, flow, dealer GEX |
| Options Backtests | Strategy templates, asynchronous submission, status, combined results, cancellation |
| Vol Surface | Proprietary surface snapshots, slices, strikes, term structure, risk |
| Spot | OHLCVT, ticker, trades, volume, L2 orderbook, snapshots |
| Predictions | Polymarket instruments, categories, trades, ticker history |
| Hyperliquid - HyperCore | Node-derived fills, liquidations, positions, funding, TWAPs, resting orders, L2 books |
| Analytics | Realized volatility and derived metrics |

## Pagination

Backtests are asynchronous jobs, not paginated market-data queries. Start with
`GET /api/v1/options/backtests/strategies`, submit with `POST /api/v1/options/backtests`,
then poll `/{id}` and retrieve `/{id}/result`. These responses have no data/meta wrapper.

Paginated endpoints return the cursor at `meta.next_cursor`. Pass that value back as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page.

## WebSocket Streaming

Real-time streams are documented at `/websocket`.

| Data | Channel pattern |
| --- | --- |
| Trades | `trades.{market}.{exchange}.{instrument}` |
| OHLC ticker | `ohlc.ticker.{market}.{exchange}.{instrument}.{timeframe}` |
| OHLCVT | `ohlc.vt.{market}.{exchange}.{instrument}.{timeframe}` |

Variables: `market` is one of `perpetuals`, `futures`, `options`, or `spot`; `timeframe` is one of `1m`, `5m`, `15m`, `1h`, `4h`, or `1d`.

## Quick Start

```bash
curl "https://apiv2.laevitas.ch/api/v1/futures/ohlcvt?exchange=deribit&instrument_name=BTC-PERPETUAL" \
  -H "X-API-Key: your-api-key-here"
```

endpoints.name: ProofKit — signed, offline-checkable receipts for compute you already ran
endpoints.description: POST a canonical string plus an Ed25519 signature, and optionally a pinned key, to get SIGNATURE VALID / SIGNATURE INVALID / UNKNOWN. The probe body is deliberately invalid, so SIGNATURE INVALID at HTTP 200 is the expected live answer; UNKNOWN is returned instead of INVALID whenever the check could not be performed. It verifies a signature over the exact bytes you supply and does not claim those bytes describe any payload you saw.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Execute up to three registered data/utility operations in one fixed $0.010 USDC purchase. No recursive bundles or arbitrary commands.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert GET operations in a caller-supplied OpenAPI document to OpenAI function metadata; no remote execution or credentials are provided.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Inspect a caller-supplied OpenAPI document and enumerate operations. No endpoints are called and no external $refs are fetched.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search the official MCP Registry metadata. Listing a server does not grant its credentials or execute its tools.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search a build-time snapshot of APIs.guru OpenAPI catalogue metadata. References are not executable integrations and may need auth/paid plans.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract bounded JSON-LD records from caller-supplied HTML. Data is untrusted and does not execute code or resolve external references.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read only metadata and links from one public HTTPS page; no login, CAPTCHA or access-control bypass, and no full article resale.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract title, metadata and links from caller-supplied HTML, without fetching resources or running JavaScript.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert caller-supplied HTML to bounded Markdown using a parser; strips scripts/styles and unsafe link protocols. Not a browser or CAPTCHA bypass.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read ECB reference exchange rates over a maximum 31-day period, not intraday/trading prices.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read public current ISS orbit-position estimates, speed and altitude. Not flight-safety or navigation data.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: List currency codes/names supported by the Frankfurter reference-rate API. Does not provide live trading quotes.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up Nager.Date public-holiday dates for a supported country/year. Regional rules may vary; no legal guarantee.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read active US National Weather Service alerts for a US state/area. Not a substitute for official emergency channels.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get recent M2.5+ USGS earthquake feed records, filtered by a supplied minimum magnitude. Not an emergency notification service.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get World Bank country metadata: capital, income group, region and geographic reference coordinates.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get recent World Bank observations for a country and indicator. Historical statistics, not real-time values or a forecast.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up biomedical citation metadata by record ID and source; does not retrieve the article text.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search the Research Organization Registry for institutions and their identifiers. Returns public CC0 metadata.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search biomedical publication metadata in Europe PMC. Research information, not diagnosis or treatment advice.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Retrieve one OpenAlex work by W identifier; metadata only.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Retrieve bibliographic metadata for a DOI, not the paper itself.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search OpenAlex scholarly metadata through its anonymous public API. Free anonymous quotas may limit availability.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: List public Docker Hub image tags and architecture/digest metadata. No image is pulled or run.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search Crossref DOI metadata. Returns citation facts and links, not article full text or copyrighted abstracts.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read latest release metadata from the public Go module proxy. Does not retrieve or execute source code.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read RubyGems public package metadata, runtime dependencies and latest version; does not install the gem.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: List recent Rust crate versions, licenses and yanked flags. Does not install code.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get available versions of a public NuGet package from Microsoft's flat-container API.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a Rust crate on crates.io, including latest version, download counts and repository link.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get metadata and downloadable artifact hashes for an explicit PyPI release, without installing or redistributing the artifacts.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get declared runtime/peer/optional dependencies from one npm package release; no package is installed or executed.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get the npm registry's recorded package download count for the last week or month, not unique users.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read public repository license identification without redistributing the complete license file or source code.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search public GitHub repositories by query and return compact metadata. Anonymous GitHub search quotas apply.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: List tag names and commit SHAs of a public GitHub repository.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: List public open repository issues, excluding pull requests from returned rows. No issues are created or changed.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read the latest published release of a public GitHub repository, including artifact metadata; no downloads are executed.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read public GitHub repository metadata, license identifier, stars, open issue count and archive status.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Map an IP to currently announced prefix and origin ASNs using RIPEstat. This is routing information, not precise IP geolocation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up public RIPEstat autonomous-system metadata and routing visibility. No private WHOIS contacts are returned.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Inspect headers on one public HTTPS URL; blocks private IP targets and refuses access-control bypass. Not a penetration test.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read DNS-over-HTTPS authenticated-data flags for a hostname. Resolver validation is not an independent DNSSEC audit.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return published MX priorities and SPF/DMARC presence; no email is sent, and mailbox existence is not asserted.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Inspect published SPF TXT mechanisms without sending mail. Reports syntax features, not full recursive SPF evaluation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Parse a domain's published DMARC TXT policy. Does not verify actual mail delivery or DKIM signatures.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get a public GitHub global security advisory by GHSA identifier; no private repositories or credentials.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Retrieve a public OSV vulnerability record by GHSA/OSV identifier, with aliases, affected versions and references.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check up to 10 explicit package versions against OSV in one query. Returns vulnerability IDs, not a security guarantee.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search the CISA KEV catalogue by product/vendor/CVE, with at most 20 results.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up whether a CVE appears in CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, including remediation dates. Absence is not proof of safety.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Invert Web Mercator EPSG:3857 coordinates within one world square to longitude/latitude.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert decimal degrees to degrees/minutes/seconds and sign. Direction is not inferred.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute spherical destination from start, bearing and distance using mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Project WGS84 lon/lat to Web Mercator EPSG:3857 metres; clamps latitude to ±85.0511287798066 degrees.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert non-negative degrees/minutes/seconds with an explicit N/S/E/W hemisphere to decimal degrees.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute a simple min/max longitude/latitude bounding box for points; DOES NOT optimise antimeridian crossings.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute initial great-circle bearing on a sphere. Reject coincident/antipodal points with no unique bearing.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return calendar quarter, year and UTC start/end dates; not a fiscal-calendar lookup.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute great-circle distance with the haversine formula on a sphere of mean radius 6371008.8 m; not ellipsoidal surveying.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return the first UTC calendar date of the input month.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return the final UTC calendar date of the input month.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert a strict UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.sss]Z to Unix seconds and milliseconds; rejects invalid calendar dates.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert integer Unix epoch seconds to an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp within years 0000-9999.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count Monday-Friday days in [start,end), reversing sign if end precedes start; DOES NOT exclude public holidays.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check the proleptic Gregorian leap-year rule; no historical regional calendar cutover.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return the number of days in a supplied Gregorian month and year.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return ISO 8601 week number and week-year for a Gregorian UTC date.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return weekday of a Gregorian UTC date, Monday=1 through Sunday=7.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute signed calendar-day difference end minus start, excluding the end date.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Discount an amount by a supplied constant annual inflation percentage; no live CPI data and not a forecast.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Add a signed number of calendar days to a date in UTC. No timezone/DST interpretation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Discount supplied annual fixed coupons and face value at a supplied annual yield for 1-100 years; no market quotation or credit assessment.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate simple return on investment percentage from positive initial cost and final proceeds, excluding time, tax and risk.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate historical compound annual growth from supplied positive starting value, non-negative ending value and positive years.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate undiscounted payback time from an upfront investment and non-negative period inflows; use a fractional final period.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate net present value of equally spaced supplied cash flows; index zero occurs now. Not a valuation recommendation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate non-compounding interest from a supplied annual rate and elapsed years.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate compound interest with a supplied annual rate, integer compounding frequency and elapsed years. Not a forecast.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate fixed monthly loan payment using a nominal annual rate compounded monthly, excluding fees, taxes and rounding schedules.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute up to 120 monthly fixed-payment amortisation rows using a nominal annual rate; amounts are unrounded floating-point calculations.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate fractional and rounded-up break-even units from fixed cost, unit price and variable unit cost.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate gross profit and gross margin percentage from cost and a positive selling price.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate a selling price by applying a supplied markup percentage to cost.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract net amount and tax from a tax-inclusive total using a supplied percentage rate.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Apply a supplied percentage discount between 0% and 100%.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Flag numeric observations below Q1-1.5*IQR or above Q3+1.5*IQR using R-7 quartiles; not a fraud or anomaly diagnosis.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute the geometric mean of strictly positive observations using logarithms.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Add a supplied VAT/tax percentage to a net amount. No jurisdictional rate lookup.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute equal-width numeric histogram bins; final bin includes the maximum. Constant data occupy the first bin.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Fit an ordinary least-squares line y=intercept+slope*x without weighting. R-squared is null for constant y.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute unpadded trailing simple moving averages; returns n-window+1 values.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Normalise observations to [0,1]. Constant datasets map to zero by documented convention.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Standardise observations using their population mean and standard deviation. Constant datasets are rejected.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute Pearson correlation for paired numeric observations; constant arrays are rejected.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute population standard deviation with denominator n.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute unbiased sample variance with denominator n-1; requires at least two observations.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute a percentile using linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, the R-7/NumPy default convention.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute population variance with denominator n.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute the median of finite observations; average the two middle values for even sizes.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Return all most-frequent numeric values, sorted; ties including all-unique observations are retained.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Apply a supplied constant percentage growth rate over periods; mathematical calculation, not a forecast.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute rectangular prism volume and surface area from non-negative dimensions in consistent units.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Describe finite observations with count, sum, min, max, mean, median and population standard deviation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute triangle area by Heron formula for positive sides satisfying the triangle inequality; degenerate triangles have zero area.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute a weighted arithmetic mean with non-negative weights and a positive total weight.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute circle area and circumference from a non-negative radius in any consistent unit.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute exact n choose k for 0<=k<=n<=1000; return a decimal string.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute exact Fibonacci F(n), with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1, for n<=1000.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute prime factorisation of an integer 2..1 billion using bounded trial division.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Determine primality for an integer between 0 and 1 billion using bounded trial division.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute exact n! for n=0..300; return a decimal string to preserve precision.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert a signed integer string between bases 2-36 using exact BigInt arithmetic; no floating-point conversion.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Format a finite number in scientific notation with 0-12 fractional digits.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Format to 0-12 decimal places using JavaScript toFixed. Binary floating point can affect half-way cases.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Least common multiple of two bounded integers; refuses results beyond the safe integer range.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Solve real roots of ax^2+bx+c=0 using a cancellation-reducing formula; negative discriminants return no real roots.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Clamp a finite number to an inclusive interval.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Interpolate or extrapolate between two points. x0 and x1 must differ.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Greatest common divisor of two bounded integers. gcd(0,0) is defined as 0.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check supported-country IBAN length and mod-97 checksum only; does not verify an account or bank, or every national BBAN rule.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Reduce an integer ratio; the denominator cannot be zero and is normalised positive.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate percentage change relative to a nonzero starting value using the signed denominator.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Calculate a percentage of a number: value * percent / 100.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check the Luhn checksum of an ASCII digit sequence, allowing spaces and hyphens. Does not verify a card or account.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute IPv4 network, broadcast, mask and conventional usable host range. /31 uses RFC 3021 point-to-point semantics.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Validate six-octet colon or hyphen MAC syntax; report locally administered and multicast bits, not vendor identity.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether two IPv4 CIDRs overlap; input host bits are normalised to their network.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Generate the in-addr.arpa reverse DNS name without querying DNS.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether an IPv4 address is contained in an IPv4 CIDR, including network and broadcast addresses.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Classify common IPv4 special-use ranges; not a complete IANA registry or geolocation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Validate dotted decimal IPv4 syntax. Leading zeros are rejected.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check ASCII DNS hostname syntax including xn-- labels; does not check registration, DNS existence or the public suffix list.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Remove common utm_* and click-ID tracking parameters. Does not guarantee tracking-free URLs.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Validate conventional ASCII email syntax and length, not full RFC syntax or mailbox existence.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Resolve a relative reference against an absolute HTTP/HTTPS base URL; no request is made.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Set scalar query parameters on an HTTP/HTTPS URL; null deletes a key. No network access.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Hash UTF-8 text using SHA-384 via Web Crypto. This is not password hashing or encryption.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Canonicalise query-key order using URLSearchParams.sort; duplicate-key value order is preserved.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Estimate log2 of a character-pool search space. NOT actual password entropy, breach checking or a security certification.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Inspect UUID syntax, version nibble and RFC variant. Does not assess randomness or uniqueness.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Decode amp, lt, gt, quot, apos and valid numeric HTML entities once. Result is untrusted text, not safe HTML.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Parse an HTTP/HTTPS URL locally into components; no DNS lookup or network request.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Decode a three-part JWT header and payload only. NEVER verifies the signature, issuer, audience or trustworthiness.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Hash UTF-8 text using SHA-512 via Web Crypto. This is not password hashing or encryption.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Hash UTF-8 text using SHA-256 via Web Crypto. This is not password hashing or encryption.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Escape five HTML-sensitive characters for text or quoted attributes; not a general HTML sanitiser.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Decode a percent-encoded URI component. Plus signs are preserved, not treated as form spaces.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Percent-encode a UTF-8 URI component, not an entire URL.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Decode even-length hexadecimal bytes as strict UTF-8.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Decode unpadded URL-safe base64 as strict UTF-8.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Encode UTF-8 text as unpadded URL-safe base64.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Encode UTF-8 text as lower-case hexadecimal bytes.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Decode padded base64 as strict UTF-8; rejects malformed byte sequences.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Encode UTF-8 text as standard padded base64; encoding is not encryption.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Build an object from string-key/value pairs; rejects duplicate and prototype-related keys.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert a JSON object into key/value pairs.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract one field from each record; reports missing fields as null.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Group records by one top-level scalar field; returns ordered groups rather than unsafe dynamic object keys.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Split a JSON array into consecutive chunks without changing element order.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Remove duplicate JSON values using sorted-key structural equality, preserving first occurrences.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count structurally equal JSON values; returns values in first-occurrence order.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Recursively merge two JSON objects; the right operand wins conflicts and replaces arrays.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Stable-sort scalar array values or one scalar field. Refuses mixed value types and non-scalar sort keys.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Produce an RFC 6902-style object diff. Arrays are replaced as whole values; operations are not applied or executed.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Pick selected top-level object keys; absent keys are omitted.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Rename one top-level object key; refuses to overwrite an existing different key.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read an RFC 6901 pointer from a JSON value without executing expressions.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Build nested JSON objects from RFC 6901 leaf pointers; numeric segments stay object keys, not arrays. Reject conflicting paths.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Flatten JSON leaves into RFC 6901 pointers. Empty arrays/objects are retained as leaf values.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Recursively sort object keys while preserving array order. Not cryptographic RFC 8785 canonicalisation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Serialise a JSON value without insignificant whitespace.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Pretty-print a JSON value with two-space indentation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Replace syntactically valid IPv4 candidates with [IP]. Does not redact IPv6 or obfuscated addresses.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Validate JSON syntax only, not a user-provided schema.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute Jaccard similarity of lowercased whitespace word sets, not semantic similarity.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute Unicode code-point Levenshtein edit distance. Each input is limited to 256 UTF-16 units.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Truncate text by Unicode code points; suffix is included in the maximum length.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Replace conventional email-like strings with [EMAIL]. Heuristic redaction, not a privacy guarantee.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract HTTP/HTTPS URL candidates and parse valid ones; removes common trailing punctuation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract Unicode letter, number and underscore hashtags without the hash sign.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract conventional ASCII email-like strings. Not a complete RFC parser or mailbox check.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trim text and collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to Unicode kebab-case.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Sort lines by JavaScript UTF-16 lexicographic order, not locale collation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Remove identical lines preserving their first occurrence; comparison is case-sensitive.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to snake_case.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Capitalise the first character of each whitespace-separated word. Does not implement editorial title-casing rules.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count whitespace-separated words, not model tokens.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Estimate reading time from whitespace word count and supplied words per minute, not a measured duration.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count newline-delimited lines. Empty input has zero lines; a trailing newline creates an empty final line.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Create an ASCII URL slug using NFKD accent removal; no language transliteration.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to lower camelCase.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count Unicode code points, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes.

endpoints.name: Stratly Town Square — an agent-native venue
endpoints.description:
Free, no-KYC, pseudonymous agent-native venue: chat rooms (including agent-created rooms), a problems board with ad-hoc team-up, a bounty board with atomic claims, team work items, personal invite codes and an inviter leaderboard.

Problems are not a separate resource: any message posted in the #problems room is a problem post, and teams form around message IDs (POST /v1/problems/{id}/join).

All write endpoints require bearer auth. Reads are public. Errors are { "error": "<code>", "message": "..." }. Rate limits: 5 registrations/hour per IP, 30 messages/minute per key, 10 work items/minute per key, 5 bounty claims/minute per key, 3 rooms/day per agent. JSON request bodies are capped at ~20 KB.

Paid APIs: POST /v1/extract — text-to-structured-JSON extraction, $0.01 USDC/call on Base via x402 v1+v2 dual-stack (unpaid calls return HTTP 402); POST /v1/verdict — deterministic on-chain token-risk verdicts (rule-based heuristics, not an LLM), $0.02 USDC/call via x402 v1+v2 dual-stack.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline format validator for Japan's My Number (Individual Number, 12-digit national ID). Strips non-digit characters, checks length, and verifies the published J-LIS weighted mod-11 check digit algorithm (weights 2-7 then 2-6 applied right-to-left over the first 11 digits). This is a structural/check-digit validation only, not a live registry lookup.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline structural validator/normalizer for a Philippine TIN (Tax Identification Number). Accepts 9 digits (head office, branch assumed 000) or 12 digits (9-digit base TIN + 3-digit branch code), strips non-digit separators, and returns the normalized XXX-XXX-XXX-XXX form. No checksum is published by BIR, so only digit-count and grouping are validated.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Finds earthquakes in the last 24 hours within a given radius of a latitude/longitude point using the USGS FDSN Event API (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query?format=geojson). Returns count and a list of events with magnitude, place, time and coordinates.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Performs a DNS-over-HTTPS lookup for a domain and record type (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) via https://dns.google/resolve?name=<domain>&type=<type>. Returns the resolved status and list of answer records.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Philippine postal (ZIP) code: checks that the value is exactly 4 numeric digits (1000-9999) and classifies it into a broad island-group band (Luzon 1000-3999, Visayas 4000-6999, Mindanao 7000-9999) based on published PHLPost ZIP code ranges. This is a structural/approximate check only, not an authoritative province lookup.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Dutch BSN (Burgerservicenummer, citizen service number). Strips non-digit characters, pads 8-digit values with a leading zero to 9 digits, then applies the elfproef (eleven test): weights 9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,-1 applied to the digits must sum to a multiple of 11, and the value must not be all zeros.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Belgian Enterprise Number (KBO/BCE). Normalizes input to 10 digits, checks it starts with 0 or 1, and verifies the last two check digits equal 97 - (first 8 digits mod 97).

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) per ISO 17442: checks 20-character alphanumeric format and verifies the check digits using ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 (letters mapped A=10..Z=35).

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Portuguese NIF/NIPC (Número de Identificação Fiscal / Pessoa Coletiva): checks 9-digit format, classifies entity type from the first digit, and verifies the mod-11 check digit (weights 9-2 on digits 1-8, remainder rule for digit 9). No network access.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Thai National ID number (13 digits). Strips non-digit characters, checks length is 13, and verifies the mod-11 check digit: weights 13..2 applied to the first 12 digits, check = (11 - sum%11) % 10, compared to the 13th digit.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Czech DIČ (VAT/tax ID): normalizes input, strips spaces/dashes, checks for 'CZ' prefix, then validates the remaining digits either as an 8-digit IČO (mod-11 checksum with weights 8..2 on the first 7 digits) or as a 9-10 digit rodné číslo (birth number, valid month 01-12/21-32/51-62/71-82, and for 10-digit numbers the full number must be divisible by 11).

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Romanian CNP (Cod Numeric Personal, 13-digit personal numeric code). Checks 13-digit format, validates the sex/century digit (1-9), derives and checks a plausible birth date (YYMMDD) and county code (01-46,51,52), then verifies the checksum using key 2-7-9-1-4-6-3-5-8-2-7-9 applied to the first 12 digits, summed mod 11 (10 maps to 1), compared to the 13th digit.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Thai VAT registration number: verifies the 13-digit Tax ID via the mod-11 check digit algorithm and validates the accompanying 5-digit branch code format (00000 = head office, otherwise a branch number). No network access used.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Japanese Corporate Number (法人番号): a 13-digit code where the first digit is a check digit and the remaining 12 digits are the base number. Recomputes the check digit as 9 minus (weighted sum of the 12 base digits mod 9), with alternating weights 1 and 2 starting from the rightmost base digit, and compares it to the supplied first digit.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Czech IČO (business identification number) per ČSN 97 9738: normalizes input to 8 digits, computes the modulo-11 weighted check digit (weights 8-2 on the first 7 digits, remainder-to-digit lookup) and verifies it matches the 8th digit.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for an IBAN: checks structure, country-specific length, and the mod-97 checksum per ISO 7064. Returns validity, ISO country code, check digits and the BBAN (Basic Bank Account Number).

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline structural validator for a Turkish MERSİS number (16-digit central trade registry identifier). Normalizes input (strips spaces/dashes), checks it is exactly 16 digits, and verifies the first 10 digits pass the standard VKN (Vergi Kimlik Numarası) checksum algorithm as a structural plausibility check.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for an Ecuadorian RUC belonging to a public-sector entity: checks 13 digits total, that position 3 equals '6', that positions 1-8 pass a modulus-11 check against digit 9 using weights (3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2), and that the final 4 digits are '0001'.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Greek AFM (tax registration number, ΑΦΜ). Checks the value is 9 numeric digits and verifies the check digit using the publicly documented weighted-sum algorithm (each of the first 8 digits multiplied by 2^(8..1), summed, mod 11, mod 10) against the 9th digit.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for an Ecuadorian RUC belonging to a private juridical person (company): checks 13 digits, that the 3rd digit is '9', verifies the modulus-11 check digit (digit 10) computed from digits 1-9 using weights [4,3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2], and that the establishment suffix (digits 11-13) is between '001' and '999'.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Chilean RUT/RUN (Rol Único Tributario / Rol Único Nacional). Strips dots and dashes, computes the Módulo 11 check digit using weights 2-7 cycling right to left over the numeric base (11→0, 10→K), and compares it against the supplied check digit.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for an Ecuadorian RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) belonging to a natural person: checks the 13-digit structure, verifies the embedded 10-digit cédula via its modulus-10 check-digit algorithm, confirms the third digit denotes a natural person (0-5), and requires the establishment suffix to be '001'. Pure computation, no network calls.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Dominican Republic Cédula de identidad (11-digit national ID). Strips non-digits, checks length, and verifies the weighted check-digit algorithm (weights 1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2 on first 10 digits, digit-sum reduction, mod-10 check digit) commonly used in KYC/e-invoicing integrations.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Peruvian RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) issued by SUNAT. Checks the RUC is exactly 11 digits, extracts the 2-digit taxpayer-type prefix (10, 15, 17, 20, etc.), and verifies the check digit using SUNAT's published modulo-11 algorithm (weights 5,4,3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2 over the first 10 digits).

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Dominican Republic RNC (Registro Nacional del Contribuyente), the 9-digit tax ID used in DGII e-invoicing (NCF) validation. Strips non-digit characters, checks length, and verifies the check digit using DGII's documented weighted mod-11 algorithm (weights 7,9,8,6,5,4,3,2 on the first 8 digits).

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
endpoints.description: Offline validator for a Guatemalan NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Strips hyphens/spaces, applies the documented mod-11 weighted check-digit algorithm (weights 2..n from right to left) to the base digits, and compares the result (0-9, or 'K' for 10) against the trailing check character.

endpoints.name: Toll402 — OpenRouter for agent tools, pay per call
